tagline: Leading vertically integrated producer and marketer of fresh and value-added fruit and vegetables worldwide
hero_kpi_rationale: The $1.04 billion in fruit purchase agreements reflect Fresh Del Monte's position as a leading vertically integrated producer and its ability to secure high-quality supply from independent growers in key regions such as Guatemala, Ecuador, and Thailand.

kpis.name: Fruit Purchase Agreements
kpis.explanation: Total value of fruit purchase contracts with independent growers
kpis.description: Fruit purchase agreements with independent growers primarily in Guatemala, Ecuador, Philippines, Costa Rica, Colombia, and the UK. Total for 2025: $655.3 million in actual purchases.

kpis.name: Long-term Debt
kpis.description: Long-term debt obligations as of December 26, 2025, with an assumed average variable interest rate of 4.4%.

kpis.name: Operating Leases and Charter Agreements
kpis.explanation: Contractual obligations related to operating leases and charter agreements
kpis.description: Contractual obligations for operating leases and charter agreements as of December 26, 2025, including transportation and logistics.

kpis.name: Quarterly Dividend
kpis.description: Quarterly dividend of $0.30 per share, reflecting the company's shareholder return policy.

risks.title: Customs Tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Customs tariffs imposed by the United States have and could continue to increase the company's costs, which could have a material impact on its gross profit.

risks.title: Inflation and Cost Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company has experienced inflationary pressures and high costs due to volatility and disruptions in the global economy, increasing its production and distribution costs.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain disruptions, such as transportation and logistics issues, could impact the company's operations and gross profit.

risks.title: Geopolitical Conflicts
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical conflicts could disrupt the company's supply chains and operations in its key production regions.

risks.title: Currency Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Currency fluctuations could impact the company's sales and costs, which could affect its gross profit.

risks.title: Tax Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to tax risks, including audits and claims from tax authorities, which could have a material impact on its gross profit.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risks related to changes in environmental and agricultural laws and regulations.

ai_positioning.summary: Fresh Del Monte did not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K for the 2025 fiscal year. The company focuses on its logistics capabilities and its position as a leading vertically integrated player in the agri-food sector.
